title: Four Linux kernel LPE flaws disclosed with PoC exploits: DirtyAH6 (CVE-2026-80844), TUNderflow (CVE-2026-81000), PPPoEject (CVE-2026-68121), DiagSpill (CVE-2026-74469)
content_md: Four Linux kernel LPE flaws disclosed with PoC exploits: DirtyAH6 (CVE-2026-80844), TUNderflow (CVE-2026-81000), PPPoEject (CVE-2026-68121), DiagSpill (CVE-2026-74469). Public PoC exploits now available for all four.
